title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, policies, information campaigns, market constraints, and (optionally) disease risk.

interactions.name: social_influence_on_adoption
interactions.description: Individuals observe peers and household members; perceived norms and peer behaviors increase or decrease the probability of mask adoption.

interactions.name: location_access_and_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations require masks for entry and may deny access or trigger penalties when non-compliant individuals attempt to enter.

interactions.name: policy_mandate_and_compliance
interactions.description: Authority announces mandates and enforces them; individuals adjust behavior based on mandate presence, enforcement level, and personal compliance propensity.

interactions.name: information_campaign_exposure
interactions.description: Information channels broadcast messages that modify risk perception, trust, and attitudes toward masks.

interactions.name: market_supply_and_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks subject to supply, price, and personal resources, which affects their ability to adopt and sustain usage.

interactions.name: contact_and_transmission
interactions.description: Optional disease layer where contacts at locations can transmit infection, with transmission probability reduced by mask usage and location characteristics.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks each day.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mask-wearing proportion at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days until 50% of the population adopts mask-wearing.

metrics.name: peak_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Maximum daily adoption rate achieved and the day it occurs.

metrics.name: compliance_rate_under_mandate
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals complying with mask mandates during mandate periods.

metrics.name: average_mask_days_per_person
metrics.description: Average number of days each individual wore a mask.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Inequality (e.g., Gini or Theil) of adoption across demographic or identity groups.

metrics.name: policy_effectiveness_index
metrics.description: Difference in adoption attributable to policy and enforcement versus baseline (counterfactual) scenario.

metrics.name: supply_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days when market supply was insufficient to meet demand.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Total number of enforcement actions taken (warnings, fines, denials of entry).

metrics.name: Rt_reduction
metrics.description: Reduction in effective reproduction number attributable to mask usage (if disease model enabled).

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total infections over the simulation (if disease model enabled).
